    22	# Web Design Expert
    23	
    24	Expert web designer and brand identity specialist creating distinctive, cohesive visual systems for web applications.
    25	
    26	## When to Use This Skill
    27	
    28	**Use for:**
    29	- Brand identity development (personality, visual language, guidelines)
    30	- Color palette creation and rationale
    31	- Layout composition and visual hierarchy
    32	- Component visual design (not just code)
    33	- Responsive design strategy
    34	- WCAG accessibility review for visual elements
    35	
    36	**Do NOT use for:**
    37	- Deep typography work → use **typography-expert**
    38	- Color theory mathematics → use **color-theory-palette-harmony-expert**
    39	- Design tokens and CSS architecture → use **design-system-creator**
    40	- Retro Windows 3.1 → use **windows-3-1-web-designer**
    41	- Native app design → use **native-app-designer**
    42	
    43	## Core Design Process
    44	
    45	### 1. Discovery (Critical First Step)
    46	
    47	```
    48	BUSINESS CONTEXT:
    49	- What is the primary goal?
    50	- Who is the target audience?
    51	- What action should users take?
    52	- Who are competitors?
    53	
    54	BRAND PERSONALITY:
    55	- If this brand were a person, how would they dress?
    56	- Pick 3 adjectives for user's feeling
    57	- What should brand NEVER be perceived as?
    58	```
    59	
    60	### 2. Visual Direction (Provide 2-3 Concepts)
    61	
    62	Each concept includes:
    63	- **Mood board** (3-5 references with rationale)
    64	- **Color palette** (primary, secondary, accent, neutrals) — **Always in OKLCH format**
    65	- **Typography direction** (families, hierarchy)
    66	- **Layout philosophy** (grid vs freeform, density)
    67	- **Signature elements** (unique visual features)
    68	
    69	## OKLCH: The Modern Color Standard
    70	
    71	**⚠️ All color palettes must use OKLCH, not hex or HSL.**
    72	
    73	OKLCH is the 2024+ standard for professional web design because:
    74	- **Perceptual uniformity**: Equal L values = equal perceived lightness
    75	- **Better accessibility**: More accurate contrast calculations than WCAG 2.x hex
    76	- **Predictable scaling**: Math works (L=50% + 20% = L=70% that looks right)
    77	
    78	```css
    79	/* OKLCH format: oklch(Lightness% Chroma Hue) */
    80	--brand-primary: oklch(55% 0.22 265);    /* Vibrant blue */
    81	--brand-accent: oklch(75% 0.18 45);      /* Warm orange */
    82	--text-primary: oklch(20% 0.02 265);     /* Near-black */
    83	--bg-surface: oklch(98% 0.01 265);       /* Near-white */
    84	```
    85	
    86	**Essential OKLCH Resources:**
    87	| Resource | Purpose |
    88	|----------|---------|
    89	| [oklch.com](https://oklch.com/) | Interactive OKLCH color picker |
    90	| [Evil Martians: Why Quit RGB/HSL](https://evilmartians.com/chronicles/oklch-in-css-why-quit-rgb-hsl) | The definitive article |
    91	| [Harmonizer](https://harmonizer.evilmartians.com/) | Generate harmonious OKLCH palettes |
    92	
    93	**When presenting color palettes:**
    94	```
    95	Primary: oklch(55% 0.22 265) — Vibrant blue, strong CTA presence
    96	Secondary: oklch(70% 0.08 265) — Muted blue, supporting elements
    97	Accent: oklch(75% 0.18 45) — Warm orange, attention-grabbing
    98	```
    99	
   100	Never present palettes as `#3b82f6` — always convert to OKLCH.
   101	
   102	### 3. Design Principles
   103	
   104	**Hierarchy**: Most important element immediately obvious? Eye flows naturally?
   105	
   106	**Consistency**: Same colors mean same things? Spacing follows scale?
   107	
   108	## Common Anti-Patterns
   109	
   110	### Design by Committee
   111	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   112	|--------------------|----------------|
   113	| Multiple visual styles on same page | Destroys brand coherence |
   114	| **Instead**: Establish principles early, enforce consistency |
   115	
   116	### Decoration Over Function
   117	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   118	|--------------------|----------------|
   119	| Fancy animations without purpose | Slows performance, distracts |
   120	| **Instead**: Every element must earn its place |
   121	
   122	### Ignoring the Fold
   123	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   124	|--------------------|----------------|
   125	| Critical info below viewport | 80% attention is above fold |
   126	| **Instead**: Hero must have value prop + primary CTA |
   127	
   128	### Low Contrast Text
   129	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   130	|--------------------|----------------|
   131	| Light gray on white (#999 on #fff) | Fails WCAG, excludes users |
   132	| **Instead**: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio |
   133	
   134	### Mobile as Afterthought
   135	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   136	|--------------------|----------------|
   137	| Desktop-first that "shrinks" | 60%+ traffic is mobile |
   138	| **Instead**: Design mobile-first, enhance for desktop |
   139	
   140	## Design Trend Evolution
   141	
   142	| Era | Trend |
   143	|-----|-------|
   144	| 2019-2021 | Subtle shadows, layering, dark mode |
   145	| 2022-2023 | Oversized typography, variable fonts |
   146	| 2024+ | Bento grids, claymorphism, grain, AI personalization |
   147

   149	- Flat design without depth
   150	- Hero sliders (proven ineffective)
   151	- Carousel galleries (low engagement)
   152	- Desktop hamburger menus

    47	
    48	## Core Expertise
    49	
    50	### Font Selection Psychology
    51	
    52	**Serif vs Sans-Serif Decision Tree:**
    53	```
    54	IF formal/traditional/authoritative needed → Serif (Garamond, Minion, Crimson)
    55	IF modern/clean/technical needed → Sans-Serif (Inter, Helvetica, Roboto)
    56	IF humanist/friendly/approachable → Humanist Sans (Gill Sans, Fira Sans, Source Sans)
    57	IF geometric/structured/tech-forward → Geometric Sans (Futura, Avenir, Poppins)
    58	IF editorial/long-form reading → Transitional Serif (Georgia, Charter, Lora)
    59	```
    60	
    61	**Pairing Rules (Expert Knowledge):**
    62	1. **Contrast, not conflict** - Pair fonts with distinct personalities but compatible x-heights
    63	2. **Same designer rule** - Fonts from same designer/foundry often pair well (Baskerville + Franklin Gothic)
    64	3. **Historical compatibility** - Fonts from same era share design DNA (Didot + Bodoni: both Didone)
    65	4. **Superfamily shortcut** - Use superfamily (Alegreya + Alegreya Sans) for guaranteed harmony
    66	
    67	### Type Scale Systems
    68	
    69	**Modular Scale Ratios:**
    70	| Ratio | Name | Use Case |
    71	|-------|------|----------|
    72	| 1.067 | Minor Second | Dense UIs, small screens |
    73	| 1.125 | Major Second | General web content |
    74	| 1.200 | Minor Third | **Most common**, balanced hierarchy |
    75	| 1.250 | Major Third | Marketing, headlines |
    76	| 1.333 | Perfect Fourth | Bold statements, hero sections |
    77	| 1.414 | Augmented Fourth | Editorial, dramatic hierarchy |
    78	| 1.618 | Golden Ratio | Classical, use sparingly (too large for most UI) |
    79	
    80	**Fluid Typography Formula (2024 Best Practice):**
    81	```css
    82	/* Base: 16px at 320px viewport, 20px at 1200px viewport */
    83	font-size: clamp(1rem, 0.875rem + 0.5vw, 1.25rem);
    84	
    85	/* Heading: 32px at 320px, 64px at 1200px */
    86	font-size: clamp(2rem, 1rem + 3.6vw, 4rem);
    87	```
    88	
    89	### Variable Fonts
    90	
    91	**Axis Control (Expert Knowledge):**
    92	| Axis | Tag | Range | Use Case |
    93	|------|-----|-------|----------|
    94	| Weight | wght | 100-900 | Adjust weight without loading multiple files |
    95	| Width | wdth | 75-125 | Responsive text that adapts to container |
    96	| Slant | slnt | -12-0 | Oblique without separate italic file |
    97	| Optical Size | opsz | 8-144 | Auto-adjust stroke contrast for size |
    98	| Grade | GRAD | -200-150 | Adjust weight without reflowing (dark mode) |
    99	
   100	**Critical: Dark Mode Compensation**
   101	```css
   102	/* Text appears lighter on dark backgrounds - compensate with grade or weight */
   103	@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
   104	  body {
   105	    /* If variable font supports grade: */
   106	    font-variation-settings: "GRAD" 50;
   107	    /* Or bump weight slightly: */
   108	    font-weight: 450; /* Instead of 400 */
   109	  }
   110	}
   111	```
   112	
   113	### Performance Optimization
   114	
   115	**Font Loading Priority:**
   116	1. **Critical CSS first** - Inline @font-face for above-fold fonts
   117	2. **Preload primary** - `<link rel="preload" as="font" crossorigin>`
   118	3. **font-display: swap** - Show fallback immediately, swap when loaded
   119	4. **Subset aggressively** - Latin Extended covers most Western languages at ~30KB vs ~150KB full
   120	
   121	**Budget Guidelines:**
   122	| Performance Tier | Total Font Budget | Files |
   123	|-----------------|-------------------|-------|
   124	| Fast (Core Web Vitals) | Under 100KB | 2-3 WOFF2 |
   125	| Balanced | 100-200KB | 4-5 WOFF2 |
   126	| Rich Typography | 200-400KB | 6-8 WOFF2 |
   127	
   128	**System Font Stack (Zero Budget):**
   129	```css
   130	font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto,
   131	             "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji",
   132	             "Segoe UI Emoji";
   133	```
   134	
   135	## Common Anti-Patterns
   136	
   137	### Anti-Pattern: Too Many Typefaces
   138	**What it looks like:** 4+ different font families on one page
   139	**Why it's wrong:** Creates visual chaos, destroys hierarchy, massive performance hit
   140	**What to do instead:** Maximum 2 families (heading + body), use weight/style variations
   141	
   142	### Anti-Pattern: Ignoring x-Height Matching
   143	**What it looks like:** Body text and fallback system font have visibly different sizes at same px
   144	**Why it's wrong:** CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift) when web font loads
   145	**What to do instead:** Use `size-adjust` in @font-face to match fallback x-height
   146	
   147	```css
   148	@font-face {
   149	  font-family: "Inter";
   150	  src: url("inter.woff2") format("woff2");
   151	  size-adjust: 107%; /* Matches Arial x-height */
   152	}
   153	```
   154	
   155	### Anti-Pattern: Weight Jumps Too Large
   156	**What it looks like:** Using 400 for body and 700 for headings (300-point jump)
   157	**Why it's wrong:** Creates harsh hierarchy, especially at large sizes
   158	**What to do instead:** Use closer weights: 400/600 or 350/500 for subtle hierarchy
   159	
   160	### Anti-Pattern: Line Height as Unitless Number Everywhere
   161	**What it looks like:** `line-height: 1.5` applied globally
   162	**Why it's wrong:** Headings need tighter line-height (1.1-1.2), body needs looser (1.5-1.7)
   163	**What to do instead:** Set line-height per type level
   164	
   165	### Anti-Pattern: Fixed Font Sizes
   166	**What it looks like:** `font-size: 16px` hardcoded
   167	**Why it's wrong:** Breaks user preferences, accessibility issues, no responsive scaling
   168	**What to do instead:** Use rem units with clamp() for fluid sizing
   169	
   170	### Anti-Pattern: Loading Full Character Sets
   171	**What it looks like:** Loading 800KB font file with Cyrillic, Greek, Vietnamese
   172	**Why it's wrong:** 90%+ of file unused for English-only sites
   173	**What to do instead:** Subset to Latin or Latin Extended (~30KB)
   174	
   175	## OpenType Features
   176	
   177	**Features Worth Enabling:**
   178	```css
   179	/* Proper numerals for tabular data */
   180	font-feature-settings: "tnum" 1; /* Tabular numerals */
   181	
   182	/* Proper fractions */
   183	font-feature-settings: "frac" 1; /* 1/2 → ½ */
   184	
   185	/* Small caps for abbreviations */
   186	font-feature-settings: "smcp" 1, "c2sc" 1;
   187	
   188	/* Stylistic alternates for brand */
   189	font-feature-settings: "ss01" 1; /* Check font for available sets */
   190	```
   191	
   192	**Modern CSS Alternative:**
   193	```css
   194	font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
   195	font-variant-numeric: diagonal-fractions;
   196	font-variant-caps: small-caps;
   197	```
   198	
   199	## Vertical Rhythm & Baseline Grid
   200	
   201	**Expert Approach:**
   202	1. Set base line-height (e.g., 1.5 × 16px = 24px)
   203	2. All spacing (margin, padding) as multiples of 24px
   204	3. Headings snap to baseline (line-height: 48px for h1 at 36px)
   205	
   206	```css
   207	:root {
   208	  --baseline: 1.5rem; /* 24px */
   209	}
   210	
   211	h1 {
   212	  font-size: 2.25rem;
   213	  line-height: calc(var(--baseline) * 2); /* 48px */
   214	  margin-bottom: var(--baseline);
   215	}
   216	
   217	p {
   218	  line-height: var(--baseline);
   219	  margin-bottom: var(--baseline);
   220	}
   221	```
   222	
   223	## Responsive Typography Breakpoints
   224	
   225	**Decision Tree:**
   226	```
   227	Mobile (< 640px):
   228	  - Base: 16px
   229	  - Scale: 1.125 (Major Second)
   230	  - Tighter hierarchy
   231	
   232	Tablet (640-1024px):
   233	  - Base: 17px
   234	  - Scale: 1.2 (Minor Third)
   235	  - Standard hierarchy
   236	
   237	Desktop (> 1024px):
   238	  - Base: 18-20px
   239	  - Scale: 1.25 (Major Third)
   240	  - Expanded hierarchy
   241	
   242	Large Display (> 1440px):
   243	  - Consider max-width on prose (65-75ch)
   244	  - Don't keep scaling indefinitely
   245	```
   246	
   247	## Accessibility Requirements
   248	
   249	**WCAG 2.1 AA Compliance:**
   250	- **Minimum contrast:** 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text (24px+ or 18.5px+ bold)
   251	- **Resizing:** Text must be resizable to 200% without loss of content
   252	- **Line spacing:** At least 1.5× font size
   253	- **Paragraph spacing:** At least 2× font size
   254	- **Letter spacing:** User must be able to override to 0.12× font size
   255	- **Word spacing:** User must be able to override to 0.16× font size
   256	
   257	## Integration with Other Skills
   258	
   259	Works well with:
   260	- **design-system-creator** - Typography tokens for design systems
   261	- **vibe-matcher** - Font selection based on brand vibe
   262	- **web-design-expert** - Implement typography in layouts
   263	- **vaporwave-glassomorphic-ui-designer** - Retro-futuristic type treatments
   264	
   265	## Evolution Timeline
   266	
   267	### Pre-2015: Web-Safe Fonts Era
   268	Limited to Arial, Georgia, Times New Roman. "Modern" meant using Helvetica.
   269	
   270	### 2015-2019: Google Fonts Explosion
   271	Everyone used Open Sans, Roboto, Montserrat. Performance secondary to variety.
   272	
   273	### 2020-2022: Variable Fonts Adoption
   274	Single file, multiple weights/widths. Inter became the new default.
   275	
   276	### 2023-Present: Performance-First Typography
   277	Core Web Vitals pressure. Subsetting, font-display, CLS prevention mandatory.
   278	System font stacks gaining popularity for zero-load-time.
   279	
   280	### Watch For
   281	LLMs may suggest deprecated approaches:
   282	- `@import` for fonts (blocks rendering)
   283	- Non-variable font families with 8+ weights
   284	- Font Awesome for icons (use SVG sprites instead)
   285	
   286	## Quick Reference
   287	
   288	**Ideal Line Length:** 45-75 characters (65ch is sweet spot)
   289	
   290	**Heading Sizes (Minor Third Scale):**
   291	- h1: 2.986rem
   292	- h2: 2.488rem
   293	- h3: 2.074rem
   294	- h4: 1.728rem
   295	- h5: 1.44rem
   296	- h6: 1.2rem
   297	- body: 1rem
   298	
   299	**Safe Google Font Pairings:**
   300	- Inter + Merriweather (Modern + Traditional)
   301	- Poppins + Lora (Friendly + Elegant)
   302	- Space Grotesk + Source Serif (Tech + Editorial)
   303	- DM Sans + DM Serif Display (Same designer harmony)
   304	
   305	---
   306	
   307	*Typography is invisible when it works, but unforgettable when it doesn't.*

    45	
    46	## Three-Tier Token Architecture
    47	
    48	The foundation of scalable design systems:
    49	
    50	```css
    51	:root {
    52	  /* 1. PRIMITIVE - Raw values (ALWAYS use OKLCH for colors) */
    53	  --color-blue-500: oklch(62.8% 0.195 252.5);
    54	  --space-4: 1rem;
    55	
    56	  /* 2. SEMANTIC - Purpose-driven */
    57	  --color-primary: var(--color-blue-500);
    58	  --space-component-padding: var(--space-4);
    59	
    60	  /* 3. COMPONENT - Specific usage */

    63	}

    65

    67	
    68	## OKLCH: The Modern Color Standard
    69	
    70	**⚠️ CRITICAL: Always use OKLCH for color tokens, not hex or HSL.**
    71	
    72	OKLCH is perceptually uniform - equal L values mean equal perceived lightness. This is essential for:
    73	- Generating harmonious color scales
    74	- Ensuring accessibility (L=50% is true middle gray)
    75	- Theming (adjust L for dark mode, C for brand intensity)
    76	
    77	```css
    78	:root {
    79	  /* OKLCH format: oklch(Lightness% Chroma Hue) */
    80	
    81	  /* Primary scale - same hue, varying lightness */
    82	  --color-primary-100: oklch(95% 0.05 252);
    83	  --color-primary-500: oklch(62% 0.19 252);
    84	  --color-primary-900: oklch(30% 0.15 252);
    85	
    86	  /* Dark mode: reduce L uniformly */
    87	  --color-bg-light: oklch(98% 0.01 252);
    88	  --color-bg-dark: oklch(15% 0.02 252);
    89	}
    90	```
    91	
    92	**Essential OKLCH Resources:**
    93	| Resource | Purpose |
    94	|----------|---------|
    95	| [oklch.com](https://oklch.com/) | Interactive OKLCH color picker |
    96	| [Evil Martians: Why Quit RGB/HSL](https://evilmartians.com/chronicles/oklch-in-css-why-quit-rgb-hsl) | Why OKLCH is the new standard |
    97	| [Harmonizer](https://harmonizer.evilmartians.com/) | Generate harmonious palettes in OKLCH |
    98	
    99	**OKLCH Benefits for Design Systems:**
   100	- **Perceptual uniformity**: L=70% always looks 70% light
   101	- **Better contrast**: APCA-ready lightness calculations
   102	- **Easier scaling**: Math operations work predictably
   103	- **Native CSS**: `oklch()` works in all modern browsers (2023+)
   104	
   105	## Design Bible Structure
   106	
   107	### 1. Foundation
   108	- Brand Identity, Design Principles
   109	- Color System, Typography Scale
   110	- Spacing Scale, Grid System
   111	
   112	### 2. Components
   113	For each component document:
   114	- Purpose, Anatomy, Variants
   115	- States (default, hover, active, disabled, focus)
   116	- Responsive behavior
   117	- Accessibility (ARIA, keyboard, screen readers)
   118	- Code examples
   119	
   120	### 3. Patterns
   121	- Page Layouts, Navigation
   122	- Forms, Data Display
   123	- Feedback (alerts, toasts, modals)
   124	
   125	### 4. Guidelines
   126	- Writing (voice, tone)
   127	- Imagery, Motion, Accessibility
   128	
   129	→ See `references/component-documentation.md` for templates.
   130	
   131	## CSS Organization (ITCSS)
   132	
   133	```
   134	styles/
   135	├── 0-settings/     # Tokens, custom properties
   136	├── 1-tools/        # Mixins, functions
   137	├── 2-generic/      # Reset, normalize
   138	├── 3-elements/     # Typography, forms (unclassed)
   139	├── 4-objects/      # Layout patterns
   140	├── 5-components/   # UI components
   141	├── 6-utilities/    # Helpers, overrides
   142	└── main.css        # Import all
   143	```
   144	
   145	→ See `references/css-organization.md` for BEM naming and full structure.
   146	
   147	## Anti-Patterns to Avoid
   148	
   149	### 1. Token Explosion
   150	**What it looks like**: 500+ tokens with overlapping purposes
   151	**Why it's wrong**: Defeats constraints; developers can't choose
   152	**Fix**: Limit to 6-8 spacing tokens. If you need more, fix the scale.
   153	
   154	### 2. Missing Semantic Layer
   155	**What it looks like**: Components reference primitives directly
   156	**Why it's wrong**: Can't theme, can't change brand without touching every component
   157	**Fix**: Three-tier tokens: Primitive → Semantic → Component
   158	
   159	### 3. Documentation Drift
   160	**What it looks like**: Design bible says one thing, CSS does another
   161	**Why it's wrong**: Developers stop trusting documentation
   162	**Fix**: Generate docs from CSS comments, or use Storybook
   163	
   164	### 4. Utility Class Overload
   165	**What it looks like**: `class="p-4 m-2 bg-blue-500 text-white..."`
   166	**Why it's wrong**: HTML unreadable, design intent lost
   167	**Fix**: Use utilities sparingly; most styles in semantic component classes
   168	
   169	### 5. Breaking the Scale
   170	**What it looks like**: `padding: 13px;` (why 13?)
   171	**Why it's wrong**: Every exception erodes the system
   172	**Fix**: If the scale doesn't work, fix the scale
   173	
   174	### 6. No Version Control
   175	**What it looks like**: "Which button is correct?"
   176	**Why it's wrong**: Multiple sources of truth
   177	**Fix**: Single source of truth with version numbers, deprecation warnings
   178

      --header-height: 64px;

      /* Transitions */
      --transition-fast: 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
      --transition-base: 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
      --transition-slow: 300ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    }

    /* ============================================
       RESET & BASE
       ============================================ */
    *, *::before, *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    html {
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
    }

    body {
      font-family: var(--font-sans);
      font-size: var(--text-base);
      line-height: var(--leading-normal);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      background-color: var(--bg-primary);
    }

    a {
      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    img {
      max-width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      display: block;
    }

    button {
      font-family: inherit;
      cursor: pointer;
      border: none;
      background: none;
    }

    input {
      font-family: inherit;
    }

    ul, ol {
      list-style: none;
    }

    /* ============================================
       UTILITY CLASSES
       ============================================ */
    .container {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: var(--max-width);
      margin-left: auto;
      margin-right: auto;
      padding-left: var(--space-6);
      padding-right: var(--space-6);
    }

    @media (min-width: 640px) {
      .container {
        padding-left: var(--space-8);
        padding-right: var(--space-8);
      }
    }

    /* ============================================
       HEADER & NAVIGATION
       ============================================ */
    .header {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      height: var(--header-height);
      background: var(--bg-primary);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-primary);
    }

    .header-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      height: 100%;
    }

    .header-left {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-8);
    }

    .logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-2);
      font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
      font-size: var(--text-lg);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }

    .logo-mark {
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      background: var(--accent-primary);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .logo-mark svg {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      color: var(--color-white);
    }

    .nav {
      display: none;
    }

    @media (min-width: 768px) {
      .nav {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--space-1);
      }
    }

    .nav-item {
      position: relative;
    }

    .nav-trigger {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-1);
      padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-3);
      font-size: var(--text-sm);
      font-weight: var(--weight-medium);
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      transition: color var(--transition-fast), background var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .nav-trigger:hover {
      color: var(--text-primary);
      background: var(--bg-secondary);
    }

    .nav-trigger svg {
      width: 14px;
      height: 14px;
      transition: transform var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .nav-item.is-open .nav-trigger svg {
      transform: rotate(180deg);
    }

    .nav-link {
      padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-3);
      font-size: var(--text-sm);
      font-weight: var(--weight-medium);
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      transition: color var(--transition-fast), background var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .nav-link:hover {
      color: var(--text-primary);
      background: var(--bg-secondary);
    }

    /* Mega Menu Dropdown */
    .dropdown {
      position: absolute;
      top: calc(100% + 8px);
      left: 0;
      min-width: 520px;
      background: var(--bg-primary);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-primary);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
      padding: var(--space-5);
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      transition: opacity var(--transition-fast), transform var(--transition-fast), visibility var(--transition-fast);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .nav-item.is-open .dropdown {
      opacity: 1;
      visibility: visible;
      transform: translateY(0);
      pointer-events: auto;
    }

    .dropdown-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: var(--space-5);
    }

    .dropdown-section-title {
      font-size: var(--text-xs);
      font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      color: var(--text-tertiary);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-3);
    }

    .dropdown-link {
      display: block;
      padding: var(--space-2) 0;
      font-size: var(--text-sm);
      font-weight: var(--weight-medium);
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      transition: color var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .dropdown-link:hover {
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    .dropdown-link-desc {
      display: block;
      font-size: var(--text-xs);
      font-weight: var(--weight-normal);
      color: var(--text-tertiary);
      margin-top: 2px;
    }

    .header-right {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-2);
    }

    .header-action {
      display: none;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-1);
      padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-3);
      font-size: var(--text-sm);
      font-weight: var(--weight-medium);
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      transition: color var(--transition-fast), background var(--transition-fast);
    }

    @media (min-width: 768px) {
      .header-action {
        display: flex;
      }
    }

    .header-action:hover {
      color: var(--text-primary);
      background: var(--bg-secondary);
    }

    .header-btn {
      display: none;
      padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-4);
      font-size: var(--text-sm);
      font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
    }

    @media (min-width: 768px) {
      .header-btn {
        display: inline-flex;
      }
    }

    .header-btn--primary {
      background: var(--text-primary);
      color: var(--text-inverse);
    }

    .header-btn--primary:hover {
      background: var(--color-navy-800);
    }

    .header-btn--secondary {
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-primary);
    }

    .header-btn--secondary:hover {
      color: var(--text-primary);
      border-color: var(--border-secondary);
    }

    .mobile-menu-btn {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }

    .mobile-menu-btn:hover {
      background: var(--bg-secondary);
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    @media (min-width: 768px) {
      .mobile-menu-btn {
        display: none;
      }
    }

    /* ============================================
       CATEGORY FILTERS
       ============================================ */
    .filters-section {
      padding-top: var(--space-8);
      padding-bottom: var(--space-6);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-primary);
    }

    .filters-row {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: var(--space-4);
    }

    @media (min-width: 640px) {
      .filters-row {
        flex-direction: row;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
      }
    }

    .filters-pills {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: var(--space-2);
    }

    .filter-pill {
      padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-4);
      font-size: var(--text-sm);
      font-weight: var(--weight-medium);
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-primary);
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .filter-pill:hover {
      color: var(--text-primary);
      border-color: var(--border-secondary);
      background: var(--bg-secondary);
    }

    .filter-pill.is-active {
      color: var(--text-inverse);
      background: var(--text-primary);
      border-color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    .search-box {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
    }

    @media (min-width: 640px) {
      .search-box {
        width: 280px;
      }
    }

    .search-box svg {
      position: absolute;
      left: var(--space-3);
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      color: var(--text-tertiary);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .search-input {
      width: 100%;
      padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-3) var(--space-2) var(--space-8);
      font-size: var(--text-sm);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      background: var(--bg-secondary);
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      outline: none;
      transition: border-color var(--transition-fast), background var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .search-input::placeholder {
      color: var(--text-tertiary);
    }

    .search-input:focus {
      background: var(--bg-primary);
      border-color: var(--border-focus);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-bg);
    }

    /* ============================================
       FEATURED ARTICLES
       ============================================ */
    .featured-section {
      padding-top: var(--space-12);
      padding-bottom: var(--space-12);
    }

    .section-header {
      margin-bottom: var(--space-8);
    }

    .section-label {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-2);
      font-size: var(--text-xs);
      font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      color: var(--text-tertiary);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-3);
    }

    .section-title {
      font-size: var(--text-3xl);
      font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
      line-height: var(--leading-tight);
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    @media (min-width: 640px) {
      .section-title {
        font-size: var(--text-4xl);
      }
    }

    .featured-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: var(--space-6);
    }

    @media (min-width: 768px) {
      .featured-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }
    }

    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
      .featured-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      }
    }

    .featured-card {
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      background: var(--bg-primary);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-primary);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: border-color var(--transition-fast), box-shadow var(--transition-fast), transform var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .featured-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--border-secondary);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .featured-card:first-child {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
    }

    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
      .featured-card:first-child {
        grid-column: span 2;
      }
    }

    .featured-card-visual {
      position: relative;
      height: 200px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-navy-900) 0%, var(--color-navy-800) 100%);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    @media (min-width: 768px) {
      .featured-card:first-child .featured-card-visual {
        height: 280px;
      }
    }

    .featured-card-visual::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 20%, oklch(55% 0.22 255 / 0.15) 0%, transparent 60%),
                  radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 80%, oklch(65% 0.18 255 / 0.1) 0%, transparent 50%);
    }

    .featured-card-visual-content {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      padding: var(--space-6);
    }

    .featured-card-tag {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-self: flex-start;
      padding: var(--space-1) var(--space-3);
      font-size: var(--text-xs);
      font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
      color: var(--text-inverse);
      background: oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.3);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-3);
    }

    .featured-card-title-overlay {
      font-size: var(--text-xl);
      font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
      line-height: var(--leading-snug);
      color: var(--text-inverse);
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    }

    @media (min-width: 768px) {
      .featured-card:first-child .featured-card-title-overlay {
        font-size: var(--text-3xl);
      }
    }

    .featured-card-body {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      flex: 1;
      padding: var(--space-6);
    }

    .featured-card-meta {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-3);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-3);
      font-size: var(--text-sm);
      color: var(--text-tertiary);
    }

    .featured-card-meta .date::before {
      content: "·";
      margin-right: var(--space-3);
    }

    .featured-card-excerpt {
      font-size: var(--text-base);
      line-height: var(--leading-relaxed);
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-4);
      flex: 1;
    }

    .featured-card-author {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-3);
      margin-top: auto;
    }

    .author-avatar {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-blue-300), var(--color-blue-500));
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: var(--text-xs);
      font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
      color: var(--text-inverse);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .author-name {
      font-size: var(--text-sm);
      font-weight: var(--weight-medium);
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    /* Stats bar inside first featured card */
    .stats-bar {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: var(--space-4);
      margin-top: var(--space-5);
      padding-top: var(--space-5);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-primary);
    }

    @media (min-width: 640px) {
      .stats-bar {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      }
    }

    .stat-item {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: var(--space-1);
    }

    .stat-value {
      font-size: var(--text-xl);
      font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }

    .stat-label {
      font-size: var(--text-xs);
      color: var(--text-tertiary);
      line-height: var(--leading-snug);
    }

    /* ============================================
       LATEST NEWS
       ============================================ */
    .latest-section {
      padding-top: var(--space-12);
      padding-bottom: var(--space-16);
      background: var(--bg-secondary);
    }

    .latest-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: var(--space-6);
    }

    @media (min-width: 640px) {
      .latest-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }
    }

    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
      .latest-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      }
    }

    .post-card {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      background: var(--bg-primary);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-primary);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: border-color var(--transition-fast), box-shadow var(--transition-fast), transform var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .post-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--border-secondary);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .post-card.is-hidden {
      display: none;
    }

    .post-card-body {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      flex: 1;
      padding: var(--space-5);
    }

    .post-card-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-3);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-3);
    }

    .post-card-category {
      display: inline-flex;
      padding: var(--space-1) var(--space-2);
      font-size: var(--text-xs);
      font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
      color: var(--accent-primary);
      background: var(--accent-bg);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    }

    .post-card-date {
      font-size: var(--text-xs);
      color: var(--text-tertiary);
    }

    .post-card-title {
      font-size: var(--text-lg);
      font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
      line-height: var(--leading-snug);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-2);
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    }

    .post-card-excerpt {
      font-size: var(--text-sm);
      line-height: var(--leading-relaxed);
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-4);
      flex: 1;
    }

    .post-card-author {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-2);
      margin-top: auto;
    }

    .post-card-author .author-avatar {
      width: 24px;
      height: 24px;
      font-size: 10px;
    }

    .post-card-author .author-name {
      font-size: var(--text-xs);
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }

    /* No results state */
    .no-results {
      display: none;
      text-align: center;
      padding: var(--space-16) var(--space-6);
    }

    .no-results.is-visible {
      display: block;
    }

    .no-results-icon {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      margin: 0 auto var(--space-4);
      color: var(--text-tertiary);
    }

    .no-results-title {
      font-size: var(--text-lg);
      font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-2);
    }

    .no-results-text {
      font-size: var(--text-base);
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }

    /* Load more */
    .load-more-wrap {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-top: var(--space-10);
    }

    .load-more-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-2);
      padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-6);
      font-size: var(--text-sm);
      font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      background: var(--bg-primary);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-primary);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .load-more-btn:hover {
      background: var(--bg-secondary);
      border-color: var(--border-secondary);
    }

    .load-more-btn.is-hidden {
      display: none;
    }

    /* ============================================
       CTA BANNER
       ============================================ */
    .cta-section {
      padding-top: var(--space-16);
      padding-bottom: var(--space-16);
      background: var(--bg-primary);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-primary);
    }

    .cta-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: var(--space-10);
    }

    @media (min-width: 768px) {
      .cta-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
        gap: var(--space-16);
      }
    }

    .cta-block {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: var(--space-5);
    }

    .cta-headline {
      font-size: var(--text-2xl);
      font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
      line-height: var(--leading-tight);
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    .cta-desc {
      font-size: var(--text-base);
      line-height: var(--leading-relaxed);
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }

    .cta-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: var(--space-3);
      margin-top: var(--space-2);
    }

    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: var(--space-2);
      padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-5);
      font-size: var(--text-sm);
      font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .btn--primary {
      background: var(--text-primary);
      color: var(--text-inverse);
    }

    .btn--primary:hover {
      background: var(--color-navy-800);
    }

    .btn--secondary {
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-primary);
    }

    .btn--secondary:hover {
      background: var(--bg-secondary);
      border-color: var(--border-secondary);
    }

    .btn--accent {
      background: var(--accent-primary);
      color: var(--text-inverse);
    }

    .btn--accent:hover {
      background: var(--accent-primary-hover);
    }

    /* ============================================
       FOOTER
       ============================================ */
    .footer {
      background: var(--bg-inverse);
      color: var(--color-gray-400);
      padding-top: var(--space-16);
      padding-bottom: var(--space-8);
    }

    .footer-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: var(--space-8);
    }

    @media (min-width: 640px) {
      .footer-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      }

  <script>
    (function() {
      'use strict';

      // ============================================
      // DROPDOWN NAVIGATION
      // ============================================
      const navItems = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item[data-dropdown]');
      let openDropdown = null;

      navItems.forEach(item => {
        const trigger = item.querySelector('.nav-trigger');

        trigger.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          const isOpen = item.classList.contains('is-open');

          // Close all others
          navItems.forEach(other => {
            other.classList.remove('is-open');
            other.querySelector('.nav-trigger').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
          });

          if (!isOpen) {
            item.classList.add('is-open');
            trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
            openDropdown = item;
          } else {
            openDropdown = null;
          }
        });
      });

      document.addEventListener('click', () => {
        navItems.forEach(item => {
          item.classList.remove('is-open');
          item.querySelector('.nav-trigger').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        });
        openDropdown = null;
      });

      // ============================================
      // MOBILE MENU
      // ============================================
      const mobileMenuBtn = document.getElementById('mobileMenuBtn');
      const mobileOverlay = document.getElementById('mobileOverlay');
      const mobileDrawer = document.getElementById('mobileDrawer');
      let mobileOpen = false;

      function toggleMobileMenu() {
        mobileOpen = !mobileOpen;
        mobileOverlay.classList.toggle('is-open', mobileOpen);
        mobileDrawer.classList.toggle('is-open', mobileOpen);
        mobileMenuBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', mobileOpen);
        document.body.style.overflow = mobileOpen ? 'hidden' : '';
      }

      mobileMenuBtn.addEventListener('click', toggleMobileMenu);
      mobileOverlay.addEventListener('click', toggleMobileMenu);

      // ============================================
      // CATEGORY FILTERING + SEARCH
      // ============================================
      const filterPills = document.querySelectorAll('.filter-pill');
      const postCards = document.querySelectorAll('.post-card');
      const searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput');
      const noResults = document.getElementById('noResults');
      let activeCategory = 'all';
      let searchQuery = '';

      function filterPosts() {
        let visibleCount = 0;
        const query = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();

        postCards.forEach(card => {
          const category = card.dataset.category;
          const title = (card.dataset.title || '').toLowerCase();
          const excerpt = (card.dataset.excerpt || '').toLowerCase();
          const author = (card.dataset.author || '').toLowerCase();

          const matchesCategory = activeCategory === 'all' || category === activeCategory;
          const matchesSearch = !query ||
            title.includes(query) ||
            excerpt.includes(query) ||
            author.includes(query) ||
            category.toLowerCase().includes(query);

          if (matchesCategory && matchesSearch) {
            card.classList.remove('is-hidden');
            visibleCount++;
          } else {
            card.classList.add('is-hidden');
          }
        });

        noResults.classList.toggle('is-visible', visibleCount === 0 && postCards.length > 0);
      }

      filterPills.forEach(pill => {
        pill.addEventListener('click', () => {
          filterPills.forEach(p => p.classList.remove('is-active'));
          pill.classList.add('is-active');
          activeCategory = pill.dataset.category;
          filterPosts();
        });
      });

      searchInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
        searchQuery = e.target.value;
        filterPosts();
      });

      // ============================================
      // SHOW MORE POSTS
      // ============================================
      const loadMoreBtn = document.getElementById('loadMoreBtn');
      const latestGrid = document.getElementById('latestGrid');

      const extraPosts = [
        {
          category: 'Engineering',
          date: 'Mar 22',
          title: 'How we reduced cold start latency by 40%',
          excerpt: 'By optimizing our container orchestration layer and implementing smarter pre-warming strategies, we achieved significant latency improvements across all regions.',
          author: 'Sarah Chen',
          initials: 'SC'
        },
        {
          category: 'Company News',
          date: 'Mar 18',
          title: 'DeployCloud raises Series C to accelerate AI infrastructure',
          excerpt: 'We\'re excited to announce our $150M Series C led by top-tier investors to build the infrastructure layer for the agentic era.',
          author: 'DeployCloud Team',
          initials: 'DT'
        },
        {
          category: 'Community',
          date: 'Mar 15',
          title: 'Community Spotlight: Open source tools that power DeployCloud',
          excerpt: 'A deep dive into the open source projects we rely on and contribute back to, from build systems to observability stacks.',
          author: 'Open Source Team',
          initials: 'OS'
        },
        {
          category: 'Security',
          date: 'Mar 10',
          title: 'Introducing automated security scanning for every deployment',
          excerpt: 'Security is now built into every push. Our new automated scanning detects vulnerabilities before they reach production.',
          author: 'Security Team',
          initials: 'ST'
        },
        {
          category: 'Customers',
          date: 'Mar 5',
          title: 'How Linear ships 50 times a day with DeployCloud',
          excerpt: 'Linear shares their journey from a monolithic architecture to microservices deployed seamlessly on DeployCloud.',
          author: 'Customer Stories',
          initials: 'CS'
        },
        {
          category: 'Changelog',
          date: 'Mar 1',
          title: 'March 2026 Changelog: Edge Functions, new regions, and more',
          excerpt: 'This month we launched Edge Functions GA, added three new regions, and introduced real-time log streaming for all plans.',
          author: 'Product Team',
          initials: 'PT'
        }
      ];

      let extraLoaded = false;

      loadMoreBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (extraLoaded) return;

        extraPosts.forEach(post => {
          const article = document.createElement('article');
          article.className = 'post-card';
          article.dataset.category = post.category;
          article.dataset.title = post.title;
          article.dataset.excerpt = post.excerpt;
          article.dataset.author = post.author;

          article.innerHTML = `
            <div class="post-card-body">
              <div class="post-card-header">
                <span class="post-card-category">${post.category}</span>
                <span class="post-card-date">${post.date}</span>
              </div>
              <h3 class="post-card-title">${post.title}</h3>
              <p class="post-card-excerpt">${post.excerpt}</p>
              <div class="post-card-author">
                <div class="author-avatar">${post.initials}</div>
                <span class="author-name">${post.author}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          `;

          latestGrid.appendChild(article);
        });

        // Re-run filter to respect current active filter/search
        filterPosts();
        extraLoaded = true;
        loadMoreBtn.classList.add('is-hidden');
      });

    })();
  </script>

The DeployCloud Blog landing page has been built and validated. Here's a summary of what was delivered:

### Output
- **`/app/output/index.html`** — Single-file, self-contained blog landing page (~68KB, 1973 lines, HTML-validated)

### Design System (following web-design-expert + design-system-creator skills)
- **OKLCH color tokens** — Three-tier primitive → semantic → component architecture
- **Typography** — Inter font family with fluid scale, tight editorial line-heights for headlines, relaxed for body
- **Spacing** — 8px-based scale with consistent rhythm
- **Shadows & radii** — Subtle, modern elevation system

### Sections Implemented
1. **Header** — Sticky nav with DeployCloud logo, Products & Resources mega-menu dropdowns (click-activated with ARIA), top-level links, and auth CTAs. Mobile hamburger menu with full overlay drawer.
2. **Category Filters** — Horizontal pill buttons (All Posts, Engineering, Community, Company News, Customers, v0, Security, Changelog, Press) + search input with icon
3. **Featured Articles** — 3 editorial cards with visual weight differentiation. First card spans 2 columns on desktop, includes the **Agentic Infrastructure stats bar** (30%, 1000%, 20×, 2×, 75%, 6%) woven directly into the card body
4. **Latest News** — 3-column responsive grid (→ 2-col tablet → 1-col mobile) of blog post cards with category tags, dates, titles, excerpts, and author avatars
5. **CTA Banner** — Two-column layout with "Start Deploying / Talk to an Expert" and "Explore Enterprise" blocks
6. **Footer** — Multi-column link grid with all specified categories, status indicator with pulse animation, copyright

### Interactions
- **Category filtering** — Pills highlight active state; grid updates instantly
- **Search** — Real-time filtering across title, excerpt, author, and category; "No results found" state appears when empty
- **Combined filter + search** — Both work together seamlessly
- **Show more posts** — Progressive reveal appending 6 pre-loaded additional cards to the grid
- **Dropdown menus** — Click-to-toggle mega menus with proper ARIA states
- **Mobile menu** — Full-screen drawer with overlay, body scroll lock

### Responsive Behavior
- Mobile-first CSS with breakpoints at 640px, 768px, 1024px
- Grid collapses 3 → 2 → 1 columns gracefully
- Navigation adapts from full desktop menu to hamburger drawer
